terms.monitoringBody:
Monitoring and alert features (fall detection, audio monitor, check-in and SOS) are AUXILIARY and depend on factors beyond our control: the device's sensors and battery, cell signal, an SMS-capable plan, operating system restrictions and correct configuration.

They may miss events or trigger false alerts, and they are NOT an emergency service, a medical device or a substitute for human supervision. Vigilaro Care is a day-to-day utility and prevention tool — use these features as an additional layer of support, never as the only line of protection for the people you love.

privacy.collectionBody:
The app requires no account or sign-up and does not collect personally identifying data (such as national IDs or your address).

The only situation in which information leaves your device is the optional Artificial Intelligence features described in section 6 — and even there, names and contacts are never sent.

Anonymous, aggregated usage data (e.g. "how many times screen X was opened") is only collected with your explicit opt-in consent and cannot identify you.
privacy.micUse: For ambient audio monitoring (baby monitor) and voice messages to the assistant.
privacy.aiBody:
Some features — the Vigilaro assistant, image analysis, the personalized report and voice — use OpenAI technology as a processing operator.

When (and only when) you use one of these features, the app sends over a secure connection, through our intermediary server: the messages you type or dictate; the photos you submit for analysis; and an ANONYMIZED household profile (residents' roles and ages — e.g. "child, 4 years old" —, home characteristics and registered medication names).

Names and contacts are NEVER sent: the app removes them or replaces them with placeholders before sending and re-inserts them locally in the response.

This data is processed solely to generate the response — we do not store it and, per the OpenAI API policy, it is not used to train models. If you do not use the AI features, no information leaves your device.

about.title: About the App
about.subtitle: Vigilaro Care V6 Neo.
about.missionText: Helping families turn the home into a safe place. We start from something learned on the job: most household accidents do not happen by chance, they happen through neglect — and a hazard spotted in time never becomes an incident.
about.authorText: Vigilaro Care’s prevention content is written by Agnaldo Fontinele, a Brazilian-certified Occupational Safety Technician with over 30 years in the field — eight of them dedicated to occupational safety, in private industry and in the oil sector, and more than two decades in refinery and fuel transfer-and-storage terminal operations, where prevention is not a recommendation: it is a condition for operating.
about.authorMethod: The concepts that organise the app come from that practice — unsafe condition, near miss and inspection routine. It is industrial prevention methodology, translated to the home and to the language of the people who live in it.
about.authorBook: Editorial basis: “O Guia Completo para Prevenção de Acidentes em Casa — Prevenção 3D” (Cia do eBook, 1st edition, 2020 · ISBN 978-65-86755-67-1), by the same author.
about.authorScope: The app provides prevention guidance. It does not diagnose, does not prescribe treatment and does not replace medical, veterinary or emergency care.
about.resetMsg: Are you sure? This will delete ALL data. The app will return to its initial state.
about.madeWith: Made in Brazil, with method and care
about.copyright: 2026 Vigilaro Care LTDA. All rights reserved.
about.creditsIntro: The prevention content is original work. The public databases below support specific lookups — products, substances and plants — and are credited under their respective licences:
about.creditsOFF: Product data: Open Food Facts, an open collaborative database, under the ODbL licence.
about.creditsEPA: Toxicology data: EPA CompTox, from the United States Environmental Protection Agency.
about.creditsCiatox: Venomous animals, toxic plants and emergency numbers: Toxicological Information and Assistance Centres (CIATox) and official health sources.
about.creditsPhotos: Photographs: the author’s own collection, Pexels and Unsplash.
about.creditsIllustrations: Illustrations and pictograms: created with the help of artificial intelligence and reviewed by the team.

fallSensitivity.title: Fall sensitivity
fallSensitivity.subtitle: How the app recognizes a real fall
fallSensitivity.hero: The more sensitive, the sooner the app reacts — but false alarms become more likely. Choose what makes sense for you.

high.title: High
high.desc: Reacts to light falls. May trigger if the phone falls off a table.

medium.title: Medium (recommended)
medium.desc: Balance between quick alerts and few false positives. A good choice for most people.

low.title: Low
low.desc: Only triggers on strong impacts. Ideal for active people or public transport users.

fallSensitivity.toggleOnDesc: Active in the background while the app is open.
fallSensitivity.toggleOffDesc: Off. The app won't react to falls.
fallSensitivity.footnote: The setting applies from now on. You can change it as often as you like.

IntroSafetyMenuScreen.segurancaDomesticaNaoEAcidenteE: Home safety is no accident — it is planning. It is the set of measures taken to minimize risks and protect the physical well-being of the whole family. Most accidents happen where we should be safest: at home.
IntroSafetyMenuScreen.aMetodologia3dDefineAcoesPara: The 3D Methodology sets out actions for Daily, Dynamic and Durable prevention, turning the home into a safe refuge. To eliminate household hazards, prevention and awareness are the only keys. The vast majority of accidents do not happen by chance, but through neglect.
IntroSafetyMenuScreen.osQuaseAcidentesETambemOs: “Near misses”, and accidents without injury or damage, must not be ignored: they are “warnings” of what can — and probably will — happen if unsafe acts and conditions are ignored. Remember: sooner or later an accident happens when those “warnings” are ignored.
